data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.content:
Coded Culinary

Home | Recipes | About

Blueberry Scones

A delightful, tender scone bursting with fresh blueberries, perfect for breakfast or tea time.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry, stirring until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, pat into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips

For best results, keep butter and cream cold. Do not overmix the dough to ensure tender scones.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - CodedCulinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Yield: 8 scones

Prep time: 20 minutes

Cook time: 15 minutes

Total time: 35 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter and use a pastry cutter or fingers to incorporate until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with vanilla glaze.

Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Home | Recipes | About

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Optional: coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips

For best results, use cold ingredients and handle the dough minimally to keep scones tender. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

© 2026 Coded Culinary. Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15.

data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Flaky, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries

This classic recipe yields tender, lightly sweetened scones perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea. The blueberries add a pop of color and natural sweetness.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 7-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with sugar.
  8. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool slightly before serving.

Nutrition Info (per scone)

Calories: 280 | Fat: 14g | Carbs: 34g | Protein: 4g

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt

  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - CodedCulinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Yield: 8 scones

Prep time: 20 minutes

Cook time: 15 minutes

Total time: 35 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter and use a pastry cutter or fingers to incorporate until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with vanilla glaze.

Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15

data.title: Perfect Blueberry Scones - CodedCulinary
data.page_content:
Loaded with juicy blueberries and topped with a sweet glaze, these scones are tender, flaky, and perfect for breakfast or brunch.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream, plus more for brushing
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place on baking sheet, brush with cream, and bake for 18-22 minutes until golden.
  9. Cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with glaze.

Tips

For best results, keep ingredients cold and handle the dough minimally.

Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Home | Recipes | About

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Optional: coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips

For best results, use cold ingredients and handle the dough minimally to keep scones tender. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

© 2026 Coded Culinary. Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - CodedCulinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Yield: 8 scones

Prep time: 20 minutes

Cook time: 15 minutes

Total time: 35 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter and use a pastry cutter or fingers to incorporate until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with vanilla glaze.

Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15

data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Flaky, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries

This classic recipe yields tender, lightly sweetened scones perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea. The blueberries add a pop of color and natural sweetness.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 7-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with sugar.
  8. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool slightly before serving.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - CodedCulinary
data.content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

A delicious, tender scone bursting with fresh blueberries. Perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

Yield: 8 scones

Preparation time: 15 minutes

Baking time: 20 minutes

data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Flaky, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries

This classic recipe yields tender, lightly sweetened scones perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea. The blueberries add a pop of color and natural sweetness.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 7-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with sugar.
  8. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool slightly before serving.

Nutrition Info (per scone)

Calories: 280 | Fat: 14g | Carbs: 34g | Protein: 4g

© 2026 Coded Culinary. Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15.

data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Flaky, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries

This classic recipe yields tender, lightly sweetened scones perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea. The blueberries add a pop of color and natural sweetness.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed

  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 7-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with sugar.
  8. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool slightly before serving.

### **Blueberry Scones Recipe**  
**Last Updated:** 2025-11-15  

#### **Ingredients**  
- 2 cups all-purpose flour  
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar  
- 1 tbsp baking powder  
- 1/2 tsp salt  
- 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter (cubed)  
- 1 cup fresh/frozen blueberries  
- 1/2 cup heavy cream  
- 1 large egg  
- 1 tsp vanilla extract  
- Optional: coarse sugar for sprinkling  

#### **Instructions**  
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  
2. Whisk dry ingredients (flour, sugar, baking powder, salt).  
3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  
4. Fold in blueberries.  
5. Whisk wet ingredients (cream, egg, vanilla) and mix into dry ingredients.  
6. Shape dough into a circle, cut into 8 wedges, and place on the baking sheet.  
7. Brush with extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar (optional).  
8. Bake for 18–22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.  

#### **Tips**  
- Use cold ingredients and handle dough minimally for tender scones.  
- Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Home | Recipes | About

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Optional: coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips

For best results, use cold ingredients and handle the dough minimally to keep scones tender. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

© 2026 Coded Culinary. Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - CodedCulinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Yield: 8 scones

Prep time: 20 minutes

Cook time: 15 minutes

Total time: 35 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter and use a pastry cutter or fingers to incorporate until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with vanilla glaze.

Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8
